blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A budget of P500 million is still needed to complete the construction of the stalled nine-story academic building in the main campus of the Polytechnic University of the Philippines (PUP), Pinoy Workers party-list Rep,. Karl Josef Legazpi on Wednesday. PUP earlier said the building would be executed in three phases and expected to be completed by 2024 or early 2025. However, the project remains unfinished. During the House sponsorship and plenary deliberations on the proposed budget for state universities and colleges (SUCs) next year, Akbayan party-list Rep.
